title: grammitis reclinata
intro: Grammitis reclinata, commonly known as the False Button Fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to tropical Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis reclinata are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may help in relieving congestion and promoting healing. The bioactive constituents present in Grammitis reclinata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
